description: This file defines a functional interface 'EventSniffer' in Java, used for sniffing events over websocket or SSE connections, with methods to create sinks and async flows, and includes a no-operation implementation.

classes.name: EventSniffer
classes.description: A functional interface for sniffing events over websocket or SSE, with methods to create sinks and asynchronous flows.

classes.name: EventSniffer.NoOp
classes.description: A static inner class implementing EventSniffer that performs no operation, returning empty sinks and flows.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a sink to handle sniffed events, given an HTTP request.

methods.name: toAsyncFlow
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous flow for event sniffing, attaching a wiretap to capture events.

methods.name: noOp
methods.description: Returns an EventSniffer that performs no operation.
